headline: IMF Reaches $2.3 Billion Deal with Egypt as Loan Programme Nears End
summary: The International Monetary Fund reached an agreement with Egypt to unlock $2.3 billion, while urging Cairo to shrink the state's economic role and address debt weaknesses.
why: IMF financing programs are critical for supporting emerging market economies facing fiscal and external debt imbalances.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Access to IMF loan tranches provides external liquidity and stabilizes sovereign fiscal buffers.
